versions.subject: Merge PR #4975 from @Murphy0801 - Add new rules related to GTFOBins
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/c89'
        - '/c99'
        - '/gcc'
    CommandLine|contains: '-wrapper'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/bin/bash,-s'
        - '/bin/dash,-s'
        - '/bin/fish,-s'
        - '/bin/sh,-s'
        - '/bin/zsh,-s'
condition: all of selection_*
